author: Stephen King
description: The intricate web of time travel, historical destiny, and fateful love as Jake Epping travels back to 1958 to stop the assassination of JFK.

characters.archetypeTag: Lead · Male · Adult · Time Traveler / Protagonist
characters.overviewBio: Jake Epping is a 35-year-old high school English teacher in Lisbon Falls, Maine. Following a quiet divorce and reading a heartbreaking GED essay written by janitor Harry Dunning, Jake is summoned by dying diner owner Al Templeton. Al reveals a temporal 'rabbit-hole' portal inside his pantry that consistently resets to September 9, 1958 at 11:58 AM. Taking the alias George Amberson, Jake embarks on a multi-year sojourn into mid-century America to stop Lee Harvey Oswald from assassinating President John F. Kennedy on November 22, 1963. In the tranquil town of Jodie, Texas, Jake finds genuine happiness as a beloved high school drama teacher and falls deeply in love with librarian Sadie Dunhill, while continuously battling the malevolent resistance of the 'obdurate past.'
characters.historicalNotes: Stephen King's masterwork on temporal mechanics, the moral burden of foresight, and the butterfly effect of historical intervention.
quotes: The past is obdurate. It doesn't want to be changed.
We never know which lives we influence, or when, or why. Not until everything is said and done.
For a moment everything was clear, and when that happens you see that the world is barely there at all. Don't we all secretly know this?

characters.archetypeTag: Lead · Female · Adult · True Love & Soulmate
characters.overviewBio: The spirited, tall, endearingly clumsy new librarian at Jodie High School who becomes the great love of Jake's life and the emotional center of the novel. Escaping a traumatic and abusive marriage to Johnny Clayton, Sadie blossoms in Jodie. Despite noticing Jake's mysterious premonitions and knowledge of future events, her trust and devotion never waiver. When her vengeful ex-husband stalks and horrifically disfigures her, Jake nurses her with steadfast devotion. In the novel's climactic climax, Sadie joins Jake in a frantic, perilous drive to the Texas School Book Depository to help him avert national catastrophe.
characters.historicalNotes: Embodies the transcendent power of love, standing in stark contrast to the cold, rigid determinism of time.
quotes: I've never been happier in my life, honey. Honeybunch. George.
Love is a uniquely portable magic.

characters.archetypeTag: Lead · Male · Young Adult · Historical Assassin / Target
characters.overviewBio: The historical assassin of President John F. Kennedy. A volatile, grandiose former U.S. Marine and self-styled Marxist who defected to the USSR before returning to the Dallas-Fort Worth area with his Russian bride, Marina. Jake spends years surveilling Oswald through bugs planted in his apartments, monitoring his violent temper, political posturing, and domestic cruelty. King portrays Oswald as an insecure, alienated lone wolf whose craving for historical significance drives him to the sixth-floor window of the Texas School Book Depository.
characters.historicalNotes: King demythologizes Oswald, focusing on his domestic brutality and lonely delusions rather than sweeping conspiracy theories.
quotes: I didn't shoot anybody, no sir... I'm just a patsy!

characters.archetypeTag: Supporting · Male · Elder · Mentor & Mission Catalyst
characters.overviewBio: The curmudgeonly, generous owner of Al’s Diner in Lisbon Falls. Al discovers the time portal in his pantry and spends four subjective years in the past investigating Oswald until advanced lung cancer forces him to return to 2011. He passes his mission, extensive notebooks, betting logs, and gold coin savings to Jake Epping, begging him to rewrite history.
characters.historicalNotes: The instigator whose tragic mortality passes the torch of temporal responsibility to Jake.
quotes: If you want to save Kennedy, you have to go back to 1958 and stay there for five years. That's a long time to live in the past.

characters.archetypeTag: Supporting · Female · Young Adult · Abused Wife / Innocent Witness
characters.overviewBio: Lee Harvey Oswald's young Russian wife, whom he met in Minsk. Isolated in Texas without English fluency, Marina is subjected to Lee's frequent beatings, humiliation, and paranoid possessiveness while caring for their daughters, June and Rachel. Jake listens to her tears and domestic misery through hidden bugs, developing intense sympathy and protective instincts for her.

characters.archetypeTag: Supporting · Male · Adult · Enigmatic Aristocrat / Suspect
characters.overviewBio: A wealthy, eccentric Russian petroleum geologist and bon vivant in the Dallas emigré community who takes an unusual interest in Lee Harvey Oswald. Jake tracks him for months to discover whether he is a CIA handler or conspirator orchestrating Kennedy's death, ultimately learning he is merely an aristocratic provocateur who enjoys Oswald's anti-establishment defiance.

characters.archetypeTag: Supporting · Male · Adult / Child · Survivor & Catalyst
characters.overviewBio: The gentle, brain-damaged high school janitor in Lisbon Falls whose GED essay recounts the horrific Halloween night in 1958 when his drunken father murdered his mother and siblings with a hammer. Harry's childhood horror serves as Jake's initial proving ground to see if the past can be changed.

characters.archetypeTag: Supporting · Male · Adult · Derry Butcher / Antagonist
characters.overviewBio: Harry Dunning’s sadistic, alcoholic father, a Derry slaughterhouse butcher who murdered his wife and three children on Halloween 1958. Jake stalks Frank through Derry and kills him in the Dunning home to save young Harry, experiencing firsthand how violently the past resists alteration.

characters.archetypeTag: Supporting · Male · Adult · Psychopathic Stalker / Abuser
characters.overviewBio: Sadie Dunhill's puritanical, sexually repressed ex-husband. Consumed by obsessive malice and religious pathology, he stalks Sadie to Jodie, breaks into Jake’s home, takes Sadie hostage, and slashes her face before Jake and a neighbor corner and kill him.

characters.archetypeTag: Supporting · Male · Elder · Jodie Principal & Mentor
characters.overviewBio: The dignified, wise principal of Jodie High School who hires George Amberson, acts as his mentor, and becomes one of his most loyal friends in Texas. Deke shelters Sadie and Jake, providing emotional ballast against small-town judgment.

characters.archetypeTag: Supporting · Female · Elder · Beloved Town Matriarch
characters.overviewBio: The beloved former librarian at Jodie High and secret longtime love of Deke Simmons. Warm, maternal, and fiercely observant, Miss Mimi welcomes George with open arms before her tragic decline and death from cancer.

characters.archetypeTag: Supporting · Male · Adult · Cosmic Guardian of the Rift
characters.overviewBio: The ghostly, alcoholic derelict seated near the rabbit hole in 1958 Lisbon Falls. Driven insane by temporal resonance, his card turns from yellow to orange to black as Jake's historical changes cause temporal 'strings' to fray and reality to unravel.
quotes: You're not supposed to be here. We are the keepers, but you are breaking the strings!

characters.archetypeTag: Supporting · Male · Adult · 35th U.S. President / Focal Objective
characters.overviewBio: The charismatic 35th President of the United States. Jake spends five years of his life in the past to prevent his motorcade from being struck by Oswald's bullets in Dealey Plaza. When Jake saves him, he learns that Kennedy's survival triggers a terrifying butterfly effect that plunges the globe into nuclear devastation.

characters.archetypeTag: Supporting · Male · Adult · Derry Ally & Vengeance Seeker
characters.overviewBio: A Derry native whose sister was murdered by Frank Dunning years earlier. Bill stakes out the Dunning house with Jake and provides essential aid during the lethal Halloween confrontation.

A far-right retired U.S. Army general whom Lee Harvey Oswald tried to shoot through his window in April 1963. Jake stakes out Walker's home to witness the attempt, using it to confirm that Oswald was the lone gunman.

characters.archetypeTag: Supporting · Female · Adult · Quaker Benefactor & Host
characters.overviewBio: A gentle Quaker woman in Irving, Texas, who shelters Marina Oswald and her babies, unknowingly allowing Lee to hide his rifle inside her garage.

characters.archetypeTag: Supporting · Male · Adult · Jodie High Athletics Coach
characters.overviewBio: The boisterous, loyal football coach at Jodie High who partners with George on school productions and becomes a trusted companion in Texas.
Sadie’s steadfast confidante in Jodie who provides sanctuary, nursing care, and town solidarity after Johnny Clayton’s vicious assault.
The iconic Derry children from King's IT who cross paths with Jake in September 1958, dancing the Lindy Hop in the park under the shadow of Derry's malevolent history.

relationships.notes: Their romance is the emotional anchor of the novel; Sadie risks everything to accompany Jake to Dealey Plaza.
